sections.body: [Primetime](https://letterboxd.com/film/primetime-2026/) — the moral position of the story is genuinely ambiguous, but the characters are sharply drawn and the setting is real, so the whole thing feels natural. The visual language is unafraid, and it works far better than people are saying it does.
